summary_en: Future Corporation will cancel 6,648,879 treasury shares (6.97% of issued shares before cancellation) on December 24, 2026, conditional upon shareholder approval of a stock consolidation effective December 25, 2026.
title_en: Notification Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On October 28, 2026, Future Corporation's board of directors resolved to cancel 6,648,879 treasury shares held by the company under Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancellation is scheduled to take effect on December 24, 2026, and is conditional upon shareholder approval of a stock consolidation scheduled for effectiveness on December 25, 2026. The shares to be cancelled consist of 6,594,016 treasury shares held as of October 9, 2026, plus 54,863 restricted shares expected to be acquired without compensation by December 24, 2026. Following the cancellation, the company's issued share count will total 88,679,121 shares.
